where: guide «How to install an eSIM on Android», section 2
en:
• Show your eSIM's QR code on another screen.
• Start adding an eSIM as above. **Samsung:** tap **Scan QR code** (older One UI: **Add using QR code**) and scan the code. **Pixel:** follow the instructions on the screen.
• No QR code to scan? On Samsung with older One UI, tap **Add using activation code** and enter the details provided with your eSIM; on newer versions, follow the on-screen option for entering an activation code.
• Confirm, and wait until the installation finishes.
• Rename the eSIM, for example to «Travel».
target:
• 在另一块屏幕上显示 eSIM 的二维码。
• 按上文所述开始添加 eSIM。**Samsung：**选择扫描二维码的选项并扫描。**Pixel：**按照屏幕上的说明操作。
• 没有可扫描的二维码？选择手动输入激活码的选项，输入随 eSIM 提供的信息。
• 确认并等待安装完成。
• 为 eSIM 重命名，例如“旅行”。

explanation: The English scopes the activation-code route to Samsung (older One UI: «Add using activation code»; newer: the on-screen option). The translation drops «Samsung» and tells every Android user, Pixel included, that a manual activation-code option exists — a step the English does not promise. Restore the Samsung scope (described, not quoted — D13).

where: guide «When to install and turn on your eSIM»
en: Installing the eSIM and starting its validity are not the same thing, and plans differ on when the validity starts. The advice that is safe for every plan: install on the day you travel, over Wi-Fi, and switch the eSIM on for data when you arrive.
target: 安装 eSIM 和开始计算有效期不是一回事，每个套餐都规定了有效期开始的时间。适用于所有套餐的建议：在出行当天通过无线局域网安装 eSIM，抵达后再开启数据。
suggestion: 安装 eSIM 和开始计算有效期不是一回事，而且不同套餐的有效期开始时间各不相同。适用于所有套餐的建议：在出行当天通过无线局域网安装 eSIM，抵达后再开启 eSIM 的数据。
explanation: «plans differ on when the validity starts» became «每个套餐都规定了有效期开始的时间» (every plan specifies when it starts) — the fact that plans DIFFER, which is why the safe advice exists, is lost. Also «switch the eSIM on for data» is narrowed to a generic «开启数据».

where: guide «How to install an eSIM on iPhone», answer 3
en: It stays on. Calls and texts to your main number follow your home operator's roaming terms; the travel eSIM is used for mobile data.
target: 主号码仍然有效。拨打和接收主号码的电话和短信，按原运营商的漫游条款计费；旅行 eSIM 用于蜂窝数据。

explanation: «It stays on» (the line remains switched on) became «仍然有效» (remains valid), and «calls and texts TO your main number» became «拨打和接收» (outgoing and incoming) plus an added «计费». Keep the English scope: the line stays on, incoming calls/texts follow the home operator's roaming terms.

where: guide «Does your phone support eSIM?», section 4
en: Choose a destination in the list of destinations, then read how to install the eSIM on iPhone or Android.
target:
根据 Apple 于 2026 年 9 月 9 日发布的说明，在中国大陆，以下 iPhone 机型支持 eSIM：iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max、iPhone Duo、iPhone 17e 和 iPhone Air。
Apple 表示，在中国大陆境外旅行时，可以在购自中国大陆并支持 eSIM 的 iPhone 上激活当地运营商提供的 eSIM；而在中国大陆，无法安装境外运营商提供的 eSIM。因此，如果您要带 iPhone 前往中国大陆，请在入境前安装 eSIM。
来源：Apple 支持文章《在中国大陆将 eSIM 与 iPhone 搭配使用》。
在中国大陆购买的 Android 手机是否支持 eSIM，取决于机型和地区版本：请按上文在设置中检查。

where: guide «How to install an eSIM on Android», section 3
en:
• Make sure the eSIM is turned on. Pixel: Settings → Network & internet → Mobile network → the eSIM → **Use this SIM**.
• Choose the eSIM as the SIM for **mobile data**. Pixel: Settings → Network & internet → SIMs → **Mobile data**. Your main SIM can stay on for calls and texts.
• Turn on **roaming** for the eSIM. Samsung: Settings → Connections → Mobile Networks → **Data Roaming**. Travel eSIMs usually connect through partner networks, which the phone treats as roaming.
• If you do not want charges from your home operator, turn off data roaming on your main SIM.
• Give the phone a minute or two to register on a local network.
target:
• 确认 eSIM 已开启。Pixel：设置 → 网络和互联网 → 移动网络 → 该 eSIM → **使用此 SIM 卡**。
• 将 eSIM 设为**移动数据**使用的 SIM 卡。Pixel：设置 → 网络和互联网 → SIM 卡 → **移动数据**。您的主 SIM 卡可以继续用于通话和短信。
• 为 eSIM 开启**漫游**。Pixel：设置 → 网络和互联网 → SIM 卡 → **漫游**。Samsung：在“连接”下的移动网络设置中查找；确切名称取决于机型。旅行 eSIM 通常通过合作网络连接，手机会把这视为漫游。
• 如果不想被原运营商收费，请关闭主 SIM 卡的数据漫游。
• 等待一两分钟，让手机注册到当地网络。
explanation: The translation adds a Pixel roaming path («设置 → 网络和互联网 → SIM 卡 → **漫游**») that the English does not give (it gives a Samsung path, rightly described rather than quoted per D13). The labels are in platform-labels.md (2926415), but the path as written skips choosing the eSIM in the SIM list before «漫游»; please confirm against Pixel page 2926415 (zh-Hans) — e.g. «SIM 卡 → 该 eSIM → 漫游».

where: guide «How to install an eSIM on iPhone», section 3
en:
• Find the details for manual installation that come with your eSIM.
• Open **Settings → Cellular** (or **Mobile Data**) and tap **Add Cellular Plan**.
• Tap **Enter Details Manually** and type in those details.
• Confirm, and wait until the installation finishes.
Useful when there is no QR code to scan.

• 轻点屏幕底部的**手动输入详细信息**，然后输入这些信息。
• 确认并等待安装完成。
没有可扫描的二维码时，这个方法很方便。

where: guide «How to install an eSIM on iPhone», section 4
en:
• In **Settings → Cellular**, make sure the eSIM line is turned on.
• Tap **Cellular Data** and choose the eSIM line. Your main SIM can stay on for calls and texts.
• Open the eSIM line and turn on **Data Roaming**. Travel eSIMs usually connect through partner networks, which the phone treats as roaming.
• If you do not want charges from your home operator, turn off data roaming on your main SIM.
• Give the phone a minute or two to register on a local network.
Menu names can differ slightly between iOS versions.

• 打开 eSIM 号码，开启数据漫游。旅行 eSIM 通常通过合作网络连接，手机会把这视为漫游。
• 如果不想被原运营商收费，请关闭主 SIM 卡的数据漫游。
• 等待一两分钟，让手机注册到当地网络。
